title: 平台对象的下拉选项自己声明颜色（如通知的严重程度），配合 #36882 去掉默认配色
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-ruled, term (6) of the ruling on #36882 (comment 7178358629; Bill, decision card 2026-11-26T00:01Z, option verbatim 「A 全部去掉，没配就灰」), filed by the owning zone under the parent. Source: maintainer.
Grading: area:ux · Feature · p2 (with the parent) · reach: every platform-object select that today gets its colour from the renderer's value table · evidence: ruling text; enumeration on claim.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：#36882 去掉按选项值自动配色后，平台自带对象里原本靠那张表上色的下拉（例如通知的「严重程度」）要在定义里自己声明颜色，否则会全变灰。
- 谁受益：所有用户；平台自带的严重程度、状态类徽章保持有意义的颜色。
- 不做会怎样：#36882 落地后这些徽章全部变灰。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

Ruling on #36882, term (6), verbatim: "Server follow-up card under this one (`domain:server`, size S): platform-object selects that relied on the table (`sys_notification.severity` is one; enumerate on claim) declare their colours, landed before or with the ui PR."

- Enumerate the platform-object select options (platform objects and service/plugin objects shipped by the platform) whose value today hits `SEMANTIC_COLOR_MAP` and that carry no declared `color`; declare the colour each renders with today on its option (`SelectOption.color`).

## Acceptance

- Every enumerated option declares its colour; the PR lists them.
- Lands before or with the #36882 ui PR, so no platform badge turns neutral in between.

Reader: zone o5-U (seat repo:objectstack#5); carried by the same dispatch as #36882 (one PR, or this card's PR first).
Note: `domain:*` is triage's to set (the ruling names `domain:server`); first-touch audit requested.
Dedupe: open issues for "severity colour select platform" return 4 (#36882, the parent; #25921 unrelated retirement; two seat posts); none covers this.
